command: echo CALL; adb shell dumpsys telephony.registry | grep -E 'mCallState=' | head -n 4; echo JAVAC; command -v javac || true; javac -version 2>&1 || true; echo SDK; echo ANDROID_HOME=$ANDROID_HOME; find "$HOME/Library/Android/sdk/platforms" -name android.jar 2>/dev/null | sort | tail -n 3; echo D8; find "$HOME/Library/Android/sdk/build-tools" -type f -name d8 2>/dev/null | sort | tail -n 3
